responsibility: Implements the frontend’s initial top-level type-resolution pass over Rust HIR items. This pass builds early TyTy representations for functions, ADTs, constants, statics, impl items, and extern declarations, resolves generic parameters and where-clauses, and populates the TypeCheckContext with item signatures and structural types before later, more complete item/body checking phases consume them.
same_name_distinction: Implements the early top-level seeding pass that precomputes TyTy entries for visible items and impl contents before later full checking, including early ADT, function, constant, static, extern, and impl-item setup. The paired rust-hir-type-check-toplevel.h only declares this initial-pass visitor.
